title_zh: 列出医疗操作咨询时要问的问题

scenario.label_zh: 列出医疗操作咨询时要问的问题
scenario.goal_zh: 说明对意识状态和潜在并发症的疑问，并约定带书面问题向临床人员核实

context_zh: 虚构就医准备：成年人请朋友帮忙整理将向医生提出的问题，不提供诊疗判断。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: My consultation about the procedure is tomorrow, and I keep forgetting what I want to ask.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: Whether I'll lose consciousness at any point. The leaflet names several options, but I don't know which one they mean for me.

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: Write that down first. What else?

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: It mentions a possible complication without explaining how likely it is in my situation.

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: Then ask the clinician to explain that risk and the alternatives. I cannot tell from the leaflet either.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: I've written both questions here. I'll take this list and ask before making a decision.
